versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the acceptance-report-generator skill.
- Automatically compiles a comprehensive 7-chapter acceptance report based on testing, performance, and security evaluation results.
- Integrates outputs from test case generator, functional acceptance execution, and performance/security evaluation skills.
- Provides structured summaries: test overview, results, module-level details, defect lists, performance and security conclusions, and a final acceptance decision.
- Supports output in Markdown and structured data formats.
